searches.reason: Replace architecture-specific residual checks with controlled behavioral probes through log2feats and predict_score. Seek matched recency, repetition, order-shuffling and history-deletion interventions, with padding and position controls, to distinguish useful sequence dependence from last-item or popularity shortcuts. Treat inference sensitivity as evidence of dependence, not causal proof of improved recommendations; bound runtime and preserve model state and diagnostic RNG isolation.

searches.reason: Build an evidence-grounded failure taxonomy from the twenty users’ qualitative feedback: immediate choice, merely plausible, unsupported prerequisite, explicit incompatibility, duplication and unassessable. Seek methods that attach supporting history and title/description spans, distinguish missing evidence from contradiction, and measure annotation agreement and abstention reliability. Use only available histories, timestamps and public item text; do not infer ownership, satisfied demand or latent traits as facts.

searches.reason: Establish whether diagnostics predict meaningful ranking failures before using them to guide training. Seek calibration against training-only held-out continuations, popularity and last-item baselines, plus bounded full-catalog ranking audits. Compare scale-invariant ranks with sampled margins, report slice sizes and uncertainty, and test whether controlled component interventions produce the predicted changes. Keep the pinned macro validation HR@10 as the sole selection criterion and limit repeated validation queries.
